description: This file implements type checking and sanitization functions for a VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) database, including numeric, boolean, enum, array, and string types, with validation against metadata constraints.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: Class providing validation and sanitization methods for VSS data types.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a JSON value based on its metadata, supporting various data types including numeric, boolean, string, enum, and arrays.

methods.name: checkNumTypes
methods.description: Template function that checks if a JSON value can be converted to a specific numeric type and within specified bounds.

methods.name: checkBoolType
methods.description: Checks if a JSON value represents a boolean ('true' or 'false') and converts it accordingly.

methods.name: checkEnumType
methods.description: Validates if a JSON value matches one of the allowed enum values.

methods.name: checkArrayType
methods.description: Checks if a JSON array contains elements of a specified subtype and validates each element.
